sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges on existing floating-rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers, and also shall not levy pre-payment charges on floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals that are sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026. [E13, E14]
Your loan is sanctioned on December 31, 2025, so the evidence does not place it within either of those two in-force covered periods. [E13, E14]

I did not find an in-force rule in the evidence that directly answers whether pre-payment charges may be levied for a floating-rate home loan to an individual sanctioned on December 31, 2025. [E13, E14, E15, E17, E18]

missing.slot: direct rule coverage for floating-rate, non-business individual loans sanctioned exactly on 2025-12-31
missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paras 260-261; pre-payment charge directions for floating-rate loans
